ONE RADIO NODE · ONE INSTANCE PER ESP8266

Messages

Send an M17 SMS and see what the other radio actually receives.

Getting started · one ESP8266 per terminal instance

Place M17Modem.ino in M17Modem/M17Modem.ino. Compile with Arduino ESP8266 core 3.1.2, D1 mini, CPU 160 MHz, MMU 48KB IRAM + 16KB cache, flash 4 MB. The same INO is used for every node.

Open this same HTML file directly in Chrome or Edge on each PC. Each page uses one ESP, its own microphone, speaker and PTT. The USB/VirtualHere ports must be available on the browser's computer; no server or Internet connection is required.

Connect USB: if no settings have been saved, the initial callsign is derived from the actual chip identifier (N + six hexadecimal digits, with MAC as a fallback). It remains editable; saved callsigns are retained. Set Destination, CAN and frequency. Non-secret settings are stored by MAC/chip hardware identity when local storage is available. No bench MAC profile or fixed frequency correction is imposed. Keys stay in the page and are not saved.

By default, the application accepts frames addressed to this callsign or @ALL on the selected CAN. The Monitor option receives every destination/CAN. @ALL is a radio broadcast to multiple nodes.

RX Gain Auto (hardware) is offered when supported by the firmware; Manual sets an index from 0–59, with no dB unit. Hardware status distinguishes the requested configuration from AGC that is actually active. This does not establish range or operation at every distance.

Drift tracking: use the Follower role with an explicit reference and another node in the Reference role. The reference requires a measured, qualified CFO prior for each remote source to resolve the modulo-38,400-Hz ambiguity; no universal value is inferred from the nominal frequency. Calibrate sends one second of standard M17 data Stream and waits for a new qualified report. After 3 seconds without confirmation, it retries with a new nonce, up to three attempts. Canceling or starting other traffic interrupts calibration. The directed report requires a real EOT, a channel guard interval and enough measurements. Short SMS messages use the existing correction without ARM. RAW control is correlated but unauthenticated; without a qualified standard, the correction is relative. Prediction during TX is bounded and is not a simultaneous RX measurement.

Diagnostics → Check terminal tests the protocol, Codec2 and cryptography locally, without a microphone, USB port or RF transmission.

Local node · ESP8266

No port open
USB closedRF stoppedNo LSF
Auto mode will be available if supported by the modem.
Frequency and radio settings 2437.000 MHz
This node’s identity · same firmware for all nodes
Carrier drift tracking Control for this node · directed reference

The reference node needs a qualified prior for each source to resolve CFO ambiguity modulo 38,400 Hz. No prior is inferred automatically from the nominal frequency. Calibrate transmits a standard 1-second M17 data Stream without audio. Short SMS messages alone may provide too few measurements. Feedback is directed and follows the end of RF transmission; no response is created for a broadcast. Calibration waits for a newly confirmed report after RF transmission ends: up to three attempts, each with a new nonce and a 3 s timeout. Canceling or starting other traffic stops this wait.

Tracking disabled. Corrections received from an unknown peer are not applied.

Stream mode options Encryption, signature and metadata · local keys

These options apply to voice and data Streams. Packet mode is unchanged. Keys are not sent to the ESPs, saved or included in the log.

Embedded sources, versions and licenses
Application GPL-3.0-or-later; RF primitives from kaboom748/esp8266_WLAN_PHY; libm17 1.4.1 reference. Codec2 source 67f31bce663caef85abb5dd2df62fb996b246c05, build codec2-emscripten 68e323e8659a24efe600422861c3b50b3944e1eb. Noble curves 1.8.2 and hashes 1.7.2, MIT. The Codec2 module uses only existing binary functions; no codec algorithm or table has been modified.
Hardware AGC: setReceiveGain(-1) and pbusWorkMode primitives, kaboom748/esp8266_WLAN_PHY corpus pinned to commit 5e67a9f150d578cce000749b9fa8db27e9f4f98d. Primitives for returning gain control to the PHY. The log ESP8266TDMAdaptive-0.4.1/ESP8266TDMAdaptive-0.4.1/validation/gain-low-fixed.json documents RF/VGA changes without manual commands; it does not establish the range of this M17 modem.
Pinned Codec2 sources · Emscripten build and patch. These links are for documentation; no network access is required to use the terminal. The cleaned JavaScript sources, Workers, build instructions and Codec2 patch are preserved in the offline archive. Download embedded sources (.zip).
